defs.def: the power to make decisions about how a country, an area, an organization, etc. is run （对国家、地区、机构等的）管理权，控制权，支配权

ex.s: Controlling population growth.
ex.t: 控制人口增长。

ex.s: Social Comparisons Can Be Controlled by Science
ex.t: 一个好的旅行社有时能帮你找到折扣票。____这样你就不必一天三次穿过好几节车厢去吃饭了。

ex.s: The part of your brain that controls your own movements lights up in response.
ex.t: 控制你自己运动的大脑区域会对此作出反应而被激活。

ex.s: Authoritative parenting is not authoritarian: rigid, demanding or controlling.
ex.t: 在研究中，约52%的父亲表现出高于平均水平的权威型育儿方式。关键发现是随着时间的推移，由权威型父亲抚养的孩子更有可能发展出毅力，从而在学校取得更好的成绩。

ex.s: It will be controlled by humans.
ex.t: 它将受人类控制。

ex.s: Controlled experiments on wrens and other birds.
ex.t: 政府可以在征得用户同意的情况下命令共享某些类型的数据。

ex.s: They have controlled the data market.
ex.t: 它们控制了数据市场。

ex.s: Data can strengthen giants’ controlling position.
ex.t: 数据可以加强巨头的控制地位。

ex.s: Perhaps your household won’t entirely make the switch, but you may have some control over your own personal spaces to make the changes you desire.
ex.t: 也许你的家庭不会完全转变，但你可能对自己的个人空间有一些控制权来做你想做的改变。

ex.s: Internet companies’ control of data gives them enormous power.
ex.t: 互联网公司对数据的控制赋予它们巨大的权力。

ex.s: When the polluting industries argue that we’ve lost the battle to control carbon pollution and have no choice but to adapt, it’s a nonsense designed to make the case for business as usual.
ex.t: 当污染企业辩称我们在控制碳污染上已经失败、除了适应别无选择时，那是一派胡言，目的是为一切照旧的商业模式辩护。

ex.s: run out of human controlB. satisfy human’s real desires
ex.t: 抵御邪恶的人类

ex.s: Often, they’ll end up filling the area with small stones and using chemicals to control weeds.
ex.t: 通常，他们最终会用小石子填满该区域，并用化学药剂控制杂草。

defs.def: the ability to make sb/sth do what you want 控制（或操纵）能力

ex.s: The ability to accurately understand how others are feeling may be used by a doctor to find how best to help her patients, while a cheater might use it to control potential victims.
ex.t: 准确理解他人感受的能力，医生可以用来找到最好地帮助病人的方法，而骗子可能用它来控制潜在受害者。

defs.def: the act of restricting, limiting or managing sth; a method of doing this 常构成复合词

ex.s: But if governments don’t want a data economy controlled by a few giants, they must act soon.
ex.t: 但如果政府不希望数据经济被少数巨头控制，就必须尽快行动。

defs.def: the switches and buttons, etc. that you use to operate a machine or a vehicle （机器或车辆的）操纵装置，开关，按钮

a person, thing or group used as a standard of comparison for checking the results of a scientific experiment; an experiment whose result is known, used for checking working methods 对照标准；（检验工作方法的）参照实验

ex.s: Invent new methods for controlling weeds.
ex.t: 发明控制杂草的新方法。

ex.s: Participants were randomly divided into two groups: the “beauty” group was asked to actively consider and then rate the beauty of each object they viewed, while the control group just matched a line drawing of the object with the artwork itself.
ex.t: 参与者被随机分为两组：“美”组被要求主动思考并为所看到的每件物品的美打分，而对照组只是将物品的线描图与艺术品本身进行匹配。

ex.s: Across all participants, those in the beauty group scored almost 14% higher on average than the control group in abstract thinking.
ex.t: 在所有参与者中，美组在抽象思维上平均比控制组高出近14%。

ex.s: Among those, the effect was greater: those with an artistic hobby in the beauty group scored over 25% higher on average for abstract thinking than those with an artistic hobby in the control group.
ex.t: 在其中，效果更明显：有艺术爱好的“美”组在抽象思维上的平均得分比有艺术爱好的对照组高出25%以上。

ex.s: Across all participants, those in the beauty group reported an average of 23% higher levels of “transformative and self-transcendent feelings” — such as feeling moved, enlightened and inspired — than the control group.
ex.t: 在所有参与者中，“美”组报告的“蜕变与超越自我的感受”——如感动、顿悟和受启发——平均比对照组高出23%。

ex.s: Importantly, however, the beauty group did not report feeling any happier than the control group, suggesting that it was the engagement with beauty that influenced abstract thinking, rather than any overall positivity from the experience.
ex.t: 然而重要的是，美感组并没有报告比对照组更快乐，这表明影响抽象思维的是与美的接触，而不是这次经历带来的整体积极情绪。

ex.s: Control group, with an artistic hobby.
ex.t: 对照组，有艺术爱好。

ex.s: Control group, without an artistic hobby.
ex.t: 对照组，无艺术爱好。

ex.s: He discovered that whether someone describes having had some control over events in their past is an important predictor of a person’s mental health.
ex.t: 他发现，一个人是否描述自己过去对事件有过某种掌控感，是预测其心理健康的重要指标。

ex.s: Besides, working in the garden seems to have a calming effect on Jaramillo’s special education students, many of whom have emotional control issues.
ex.t: 此外，在菜园里劳作似乎对哈拉米略的特殊教育学生有镇静作用，他们中许多人存在情绪控制问题。

ex.s: Phytoplankton have been used to control global climate
ex.t: 从这篇文章中我们可以了解到什么？

defs.def: a place where orders are given or where checks are made; the people who work in this place 指挥（或检查、控制）站；指挥（或检查、控制）人员

ex.s: “Let them feel like they have some control over it.”
ex.t: 可以想象，类似于以往科学模型的构建过程，开发基于"计算机模拟"隐喻的模型也将是一项极具回报的练习。

ex.s: To control weeds in large gardens.
ex.t: 语言能力受限于自律。

ex.s: That’s something we all have control over.
ex.t: 太阳能农场：一种新发展

ex.s: How to control the budget when buying groceries.
ex.t: 如何控制购买杂货的预算。

ex.s: The temperature on rail cars is often hard to control.
ex.t: 车厢内的温度通常难以控制。

ex.s: made room forB. taken control of
ex.t: made room forB. taken control of

ex.s: It aims to control the number of the animals.
ex.t: 它旨在控制动物数量。

ex.s: Students are encouraged to take control of their own learning,                just depending on the teacher.
ex.t: 学生们被鼓励掌控自己的学习                不只是依赖老师。

ex.s: New ways of measuring time can help to control Earth systems．
ex.t: 新的计时方式有助于控制地球系统．

ex.s: Biologist Edmond Mouton runs the nutria control program for Louisiana.
ex.t: 生物学家Edmond Mouton负责路易斯安那州的海狸鼠控制项目。

ex.s: Control their behaviors.
ex.t: 向他们解释规则。

ex.s: Control their feelings.
ex.t: 控制情绪。

ex.s: Some time after 10，000 BC，people made the first real attempt to control the world they lived ___56___ ，through agriculture.
ex.t: 数千年来，他们开始较少依赖   ___57___ 可以从野外猎取或采集的东西，更多地依赖他们饲养的动物和种植的作物。

ex.s: Restaurants can offer a choice of music along with the various food choices on the menu, allowing customers more control over the atmosphere in which they are dining.
ex.t: 餐厅可以在菜单上各种食物选择之外提供音乐选择，让顾客更多地掌控用餐氛围。

ex.s: strict control over any suspicious customer
ex.t: 为企业提供不同的音乐选择

ex.s: Fire control measures.
ex.t: 防火措施。

ex.s: Mathematical models have also revealed that food webs may be unstable， where small changes of top predators can lead to big effects throughout entire ecosystems． In the 1960s， scientists proposed that predators at the top of a food web had a surprising amount of control over the size of populations of other species﹣including species they did not directly attack．
ex.t: 数学模型也揭示，食物网可能不稳定，顶级捕食者的微小变化会在整个生态系统引发巨大效应。20世纪60年代，科学家提出，食物网顶端的捕食者对包括它们不直接攻击的物种在内的其他物种种群规模有着惊人的控制力。

ex.s: Garbage Collection and Waste Control
ex.t: 作为文化象征而言，美国汽车相当年轻。

ex.s: Spanish control over Florida.
ex.t: 伦敦的一个失物招领处。

ex.s: Understanding these reasons will control our own anger if we are willing to evaluate ourselves with a critical eye.
ex.t: 若我们愿意以批判眼光审视自己，理解这些原因就能控制自己的愤怒。

ex.s: The second principle is to loosen the control that providers of on-line services have over data and give more to those who supply them.
ex.t: 第二条原则是放松在线服务提供商对数据的控制，将更多控制权交给数据提供者。

ex.s: What is the purpose of loosening the giants’ control of data?
ex.t: 放松巨头对数据控制的目的是什么？

defs.def: (on a computer keyboard) a key that you press when you want to perform a particular operation （键盘上的）控制键
to direct or manage an organization, an area or a situation 掌管，管理，控制，操纵（某机构、地区或局势）

ex.s: But by learning healthier ways to manage emotions, you can regain control over the food you eat and your feelings.
ex.t: 但通过学习更健康的方式来管理情绪，你可以重新控制自己的饮食和情绪。

defs.def: to be able to organize your life well and keep calm 处之泰然；安之若素

ex.s: She says it is essential that we keep control of artificial intelligence, or risk being sidelined and perhaps even worse.
ex.t: 她说，我们必须始终掌控人工智能，否则就有被边缘化甚至更糟的风险。

ex.s: Make joint efforts to keep it under control.
ex.t: 共同努力将其置于掌控之下。

ex.s: His parents were not quite able to keep theirs under control.
ex.t: 他的父母不太能控制住他们的情绪。

ex.s: They hoped that wolves would be able to control the elk and coyote problems.
ex.t: 他们希望狼能够控制麋鹿和土狼的问题。

ex.s: But the look on everybody’s face when you’re finished and packing, it’s the best smile in the world; and there’s nobody hurt, and the well’s under control.
ex.t: 但当你完成工作、收拾东西时，每个人脸上的表情是世界上最棒的笑容；没有人受伤，情况已得到控制。

defs.def: to have power over a person, company, country, etc. so that you are able to decide what they must do or how it is run 指挥；控制；掌管；支配

ex.s: It also has a voice control setting that enables you to stay hands-free, while its waterproof band is fully adjustable so that it is comfortable to wear.
ex.t: 它还有语音控制设置，让你可以解放双手，而防水表带可以完全调节，佩戴舒适。

ex.s: Gregor Mendel 4_______ study pea plants because their characteristics were easy to control.
ex.t: 格雷戈尔·孟德尔研究豌豆植物，因为它们的特征容易控制。

ex.s: SELF-CONTROL Questionnaire 1 Do you ever lose your temper with your family, friends, or classmates?
ex.t: 自我控制问卷：你是否曾经对家人、朋友或同学发脾气？

ex.s: It was from then on that his grandchildren started to be in control of what to do with the money they receive: spend save, invest or give?
ex.t: 从那时起，他的孙辈们开始自主决定如何使用收到的钱：消费、储蓄、投资还是捐赠？

defs.def: to limit sth or make it happen in a particular way 限制；限定

ex.s: We’re looking at the benefits of systems which control their speed as a way of preventing that.
ex.t: 我们正在研究控制车速的系统的好处，以此作为预防手段。

defs.def: to stop sth from spreading or getting worse 阻止蔓延（或恶化）

ex.s: A．By getting illegal practices under control．
ex.t: A．通过控制非法行为。

defs.def: to make sth, such as a machine or system, work in the way that you want it to 操纵，控制（机器或系统等）

ex.s: And unplanned human activities have proved the idea of top﹣down control by top predators to be true． In the ocean， we fished for top predators such as cod on an industrial scale， while on land， we killed off large predators such as wolves． These actions have greatly affected the ecological balance．
ex.t: 而无计划的人类活动证实了顶级捕食者自上而下控制的观点。在海洋，我们工业化规模捕捞鳕鱼等顶级捕食者；在陆地，我们消灭了狼等大型捕食者。这些行为极大地影响了生态平衡。

defs.def: to manage to make yourself remain calm, even though you are upset or angry 抑制；克制
